archer.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. REBUILD the walking reference as a CLEAR FAST RUN/SPRINT ANIMATION, exactly FOUR DIFFERENT full-body pixel sprites in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW of FOUR equal-width cells. All four face SCREEN LEFT in SIDE PROFILE. Same character, equipment and compact approx2.2heads-tall proportions. This must visibly be RUNNING, not walking: forward-leaning torso about10-15degrees, high driving knee, sharply bent trailing knee/heel near hip, strong opposite free-arm pump with bent elbow, TWO AIRBORNE poses with BOTH boots clearly lifted, longer stride and dynamic coat tails. No weapon firing/casting. Frame1 LEFTWARD contact near leg stretches forward landing, far leg bent behind/heel up, free arm back. Frame2 FLIGHT both feet off ground: near leg pushes back and folds, far knee drives forward high, free arm pumps through. Frame3 OPPOSITE CONTACT far leg stretches forward landing, near leg folded back, free arm forward (clearly not frame1). Frame4 OPPOSITE FLIGHT near knee drives forward high, far heel folds up/back, free arm back-through. Same horizontal ground guide/baseline across cells, but frames2/4 boots ABOVE that contact baseline. Keep head orientation/hair shape constant with a tiny natural vertical bob, no head wobble/turn. No extra limbs/ghost hands, no overlapping sprites. Coarse crisp square pixel-art shading, visible pixel clusters and stair-step outlines, no smoothing/blur/gradient/glow. True transparent background, NO floor/shadow/haze/checkerboard/labels/grid. Keep every hair tip and weapon entirely inside each cell with generous margins. Four sequential poses1-2-3-4 form a seamless running cycle.
Keep brown hair, navy/cream tunic, leather gloves/belt/boots, back quiver and ONE wooden bow. Carry bow securely in one hand low but angled safely off ground while running, other arm pumps strongly. No nocking/shooting. All frames' bow/quiver designs and attachment stay the same.
